notes.title: Game Update Ver2.00S
notes.content:
Fixed:

- Direction character faces when spoken to.
- Issue when interacting with certain objects.
- Issue when using keys.
- Issue with doors.
- The Skill "Search" where objects don't function when obtaining items.
- Under specific conditions Party Members wouldn't "Talk"
- MP display issues during combat
- Issue under specific conditions, during combat, with Skill "Double Attack"
- Issue with party order under specific conditions
- Display effects
- Issue with "Chaos Beast"
- Display errors with Achievement effects under specific conditions

Changed:

- When examining an object that can be opened using a specific item such as a key, if you have that item, you will be given the option to use it or not.
- Allocated "Talk" in Menu "Party" to "1" on the numeric keypad.
- Allocated "Investigate" to "V" on the keyboard and "3" on the numeric keypad.
- Allocated Skill "Search" to "F" on the keyboard and "." On the numeric keypad.
- Added the walking graphic of the main character to the display information of the save data.
- The "→" that switches pages between Items and Skills is now yellow for easy distinction.
-Items that stack, such as arrows and bullets, gain priority when added to the inventory of the character who has the same item.
- In the number selection for stackable items, such as arrows and bullets, the number selected is changed from "1" to "all".
- You can now see the change in attack power when selecting a weapon in "Item".
- Skill "Search" now shows some objects that give hints on where to go.
- In some events, we have added conversations that will give you walkthrough tips.
- Added new branching conversation texts about "Chaos Beast".
- Added party information during battle to display the current SAN and stress gauge under abnormal conditions.
- Skill list during battle displays only Skills that can be used during battle.
- Explanation of Items and Skills are visible during battle.
- In certain maps, the amount of some items from enemy drops has been slightly increased.
- Equipment requirements for some weapons reduced.
- The developer logo has been updated.
